anchor_vanilla: Suffocation debuff: 20 HP/s (terraria.wiki.gg); for scale, lava contact: 80 + On Fire! 7 s
effects: no life regeneration; move speed x0.5 (the vanilla Slow debuff's strength) on top of vanilla water's halved movement; not stretched in Expert/Master (LongerExpertDebuff = false)
tradeoff_note: Set by the user (2026-10-23): 20 damage every half second. A progression barrier, not a combat hazard: double suffocation's drain on purpose so the pool can't be swum before the diving item (which will grant buffImmune). Like Calamity's Sulphurous Sea the biome turns ALL its water into tar, so the yard's 2-3-tile puddles burn too: a quick dip costs 40-80 life (D5 sim: 4 ticks, 80), wading an 8-tile puddle about 160 (lethal at 100 max life). Puddles are jumpable. Options if too punishing: harmless puddles (pool only), fewer/shallower puddles, or a weaker tick outside the pool. 2026-11-03 (user: 'half tar poisoning damage'): 10 every 0.5 s (TarPlayer.TickDamage 20 -> 10, shared by players and enemies; lifeRegen -40 on enemies, chunks of 10), the slow unchanged.
